# @edwyn/signature-style — The Signature Style

> Catppuccin Mocha-based design system: Token Cascade, Override Protocol, Chromatic Palette content colors, mechanical physics.

The official machine-readable index for AI agents. Full self-contained version: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — every token, every rule, every copy-paste snippet + prop tables. Package source: [npm:@edwyn/signature-style](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@edwyn/signature-style).

## Tokens

- [tokens.json](https://unpkg.com/@edwyn/signature-style/tokens.json): the machine-readable token manifest — the 51-token whitelist, Mocha + Latte themes, the surface themes (Mocha / OLED true-black / Daylight) with the computed daylight ink variants, the geometry presets, shared tokens, the Chromatic Palette, the doctrine objects
- [llms-full.txt — The 50-Token Whitelist](llms-full.txt): every token with value + description, rendered from tokens.json — plus the three verified surface themes and the daylight ink-variant ratio table
- [css/tokens.css](https://unpkg.com/@edwyn/signature-style/css/tokens.css): the cascade source — theme blocks, geometry presets, 37 colors + 13 spatial/z/type/motion tokens in @layer tokens

## Rules

- [SYSTEM_PROMPT.md](https://unpkg.com/@edwyn/signature-style/SYSTEM_PROMPT.md): The Dynamic Signature Engine v3.0 — the Token Cascade, the Override Protocol, the Structural Pillars, the Pruning Protocol, the Rule of Engagement, and the Universal AI Replication Contract
- [llms-full.txt — The Rules](llms-full.txt): the doctrines rendered verbatim-in-spirit
- One-line doctrine: every state derives from the core tokens via color-mix()/transforms; --sig-* is content-only, Flamingo/Teal structural-only; separation is hairlines, never shadows (the ONE sanction: css/surface.css's elevation blocks).

## Component Sets

The 6-Set Taxonomy — 56 documented exports, one copy-paste snippet each:

- [Set 01 — Shell & Navigation](llms-full.txt): ThemeProvider, GlobalNav, Tabs, SigShell (live demos + copy-paste in the playground's Pattern Studio)
- [Set 02 — Surface & Card Archetypes](llms-full.txt): SurfaceCard, PageHero, Icon, Avatar, SigBadge, ContentCard, ReferenceCard, TierCard, ProfileCard, ActionTile, FlipCard, AccordionCard, MatchupCard (live demos + copy-paste in the playground's Pattern Studio)
- [Set 03 — Ergonomic Forms & Inputs](llms-full.txt): FormField, Input, TextArea, Select, Checkbox, RadioCardGroup, ToggleSwitch, PasswordInput, Button (live demos + copy-paste in the playground's Pattern Studio)
- [Set 04 — Analytical Telemetry & Graphs](llms-full.txt): ProgressBar, StatRing, StatCard, Sparkline, BarChart, AreaChart, KnowledgeGraph, smoothPath, layoutGraph, cubicBezierEdge (live demos + copy-paste in the playground's Pattern Studio)
- [Set 05 — Chronology & Planners](llms-full.txt): EventTimeline, useModal, EventModal, TimelineManager, ChronicleTimeline (live demos + copy-paste in the playground's Pattern Studio)
- [Set 06 — Data, Editorial & Feedback](llms-full.txt): DataTable, Callout, Carousel, CarouselItem, ProseBlock, AnnouncementBanner, EmptyState, ToastProvider, useToast (live demos + copy-paste in the playground's Pattern Studio)
- [Set 07 — Web Components (zero-react)](llms-full.txt): SigWcSurfaceCard, SigWcBadge, SigWcProgressBar, SigWcStatRing, SigWcCallout, SigWcCarousel (live demos + copy-paste in the playground's Pattern Studio)
- [Set 08 — Motion & Kinetics](llms-full.txt): KineticTokens, AnimatedNumber, MotionReveal, KineticSurface, MotionLabTimeDilation, FallbackFirstData, AuroraBorderCard, TiltSurface, StatusBeacon, WaveformBars (live demos + copy-paste in the playground's Motion Lab)
